description: Build mining rigs, hire overseers, earn while away. Prestige for a permanent multiplier, rig skins. Local save. Batch 23: prestige progress. Batch 24: earnings rate (credits/sec after prestige + overseer boost) in state. Batch 26: seconds to prestige at the current earnings rate, in state + panel. Batch 27: next rig cost + seconds to next rig, in state + panel. Batch 29: lifetime earnings per owned rig, in state + panel. Batch 31: average rig level. Batch 33: earnings per rig. Batch 35: earnings per overseer. Batch 37: lifetime-per-overseer average. Batch 38: rigs-per-overseer average. Batch 39: credits-per-overseer average. Batch 43: earnings-per-prestige average. Batch 44: overseers-per-rig average. Batch 45: overseers-per-prestige average. Batch 46: rigs-per-prestige average.
